messages.en:
{07 04 00}Wha--? Huh? What? {01 00 00 14 00}{07 16 00}I'm
probably going to be asleep
by then, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0b 00}Could you make it a little
earlier, maybe?
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Mis--? Ah? Mida? {01 00 00 14 00}{07 16 00}Ma olen
selleks ajaks ilmselt
magama jäänud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0b 00}Kas sa saaksid selle veidi
varasemaks teha, ehk?

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Sorry. I know I sound like
a total dud, but I'll
probably be in bed by then.
{07 0b 00}Do you think you could pick
another time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Vabandust. Ma tean, et
kõlan nagu täielik tuhnik,
aga olen siis vist voodis.
{07 0b 00}Kas sa saaksid valida
mõne teise aja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
